name: Pokémon: To Be a Pokémon Master
original_name: Pokémon: To Be a Pokémon Master
overview: Pokémon: To Be a Pokémon Master is an 11-episode special mini-series that serves as the final arc of Pokémon Ultimate Journeys: The Series (Season 25), concluding Ash Ketchum's story. It is best watched immediately after finishing the Masters 8 Tournament arc in Ultimate Journeys to see the final chapter of Ash and Pikachu's journey.
